source: PHC Core Rules v1.0 (Classes) + PHC Class Roster, Revision 3 (docs/design/class-roster-rev3-proposal.md, accepted 8 Nov 2026)

assignment.score: Each base class belongs to one of the nine attributes.
assignment.eligible: At level 3 you get the class of your highest attribute. If several attributes are tied for highest, you can take the class of any of them.
assignment.tie_rule: On a tie the player chooses among the tied classes. Nobody goes without a class.
assignment.fixed: The class you get at level 3 is yours for good.
assignment.rank_rule: Each rank gives you the class's two moves of that rank. Rank II needs the class's own attribute at 5 and level 6. Rank III needs it at 8 and level 12.
assignment.moves: a rank's move is either written in full (a Revision 3 move) or {"ref": "<origin>.<moveId>"}: a move from the pool or an advanced class, kept under its old key class:<origin>.<moveId>

advanced.shelved_text: Advanced classes: sealed, not yet issued.
advanced.held_rule: A character who already holds an advanced class keeps it on the sheet, but it gives no moves, resources or effects until advanced classes can be learned.
advanced.hybrid_rule: A hybrid class pairs its base attribute with an attribute from another Core.
advanced.squared_rule: A squared class pairs its base attribute with itself.

assignment.patrons: Prayer is not a class: any character with Faith 1 or more prays Whispers, and from Faith 3 Hymns (rules 1.31; the Faithful to their patron, an Atheist by dice).

resource.rule: Guard is Durability's pool: a point for each point of Durability, up to the pool's cap, and Brace fills it. The Bulwark's own pool is larger, whatever its Durability: {=max_by_rank.1} at rank I, {=max_by_rank.2} at rank II, {=max_by_rank.3} at rank III (rules 1.59). While you hold Guard you Interpose: when an enemy's weapon attack hits an ally next to you, you spend Guard and your reaction and take the hit yourself, with your own armour. Each point of Guard can also take damage off a hit on you; the Guard row on the fight screen gives the pool's size and what a point takes off, from Guard's own numbers (techniques.json rules.guard). Guard is lost when the fight ends.

moves.name: Shrug It Off
moves.text: Bleeding, Slowed, Weakened and Prone end at once · {=effects.0.cost.value} Guard and your reaction

moves.name: Anchor
moves.text: Braced: can't be pushed, pulled or knocked Prone · a foe leaving your reach provokes an attack

resource.rule: Momentum is a pool of up to 5 points; you start each fight with 1, and the Breaker's Wind-up adds 2 more (3). Each hit with a plain melee attack, a Lunge, a Riposte or a Finisher gives 1. On your first melee attack each turn you also gain 1 for each tile you closed on the target that turn, up to 2. Each tile you walk costs 1, and so does each hit you take, unless you Parry it or your Guard takes part of it. Momentum carries over from turn to turn and is lost when the fight ends.

moves.name: Wind-up
moves.text: Start each fight with +{=effects.0.value} Momentum
moves.source: rules 1.60 item 4621 (R3): replaces the Breaker's Shove (the generic Shove action stays for everyone)

moves.name: Read the Swing
moves.text: A melee miss against you gives {=effects.0.value} Momentum, once a round
moves.source: rules 1.60 item 4624 (R6): replaces Lingering Dread on the Breaker (Fear is another door's outcome; the shelved Shade keeps its row)

moves.name: Unstoppable
moves.text: 1 AP, once a scene: until your next turn Fear, Shaken, Slowed and Pinned don't affect you and nobody gets an opportunity attack on you · +{=effects.3.value} Momentum

gain.name: The Charge Carries
gain.text: A Charge of yours that hits gives {=effects.0.value} Momentum on top of closing in, with any weapon, and tries to bowl its target over: it makes a Body save against your Raw Power (the save Launch uses), and on a failure it is Off Balance and falls Prone. A Boss is never bowled over.

gain.name: Four Ways to Finish
gain.text: You know Cleave, Break and Coup with any melee weapon or bare hands. Your Cleave has {=effects.3.value|signed} to hit (any weapon is its home). Your Break leaves its target Exposed. Your Coup against a foe under {=effects.5.if.target_hp_below|pct}% HP is {=effects.5.value|signed} to hit and deals {=effects.6.value|more}% more: an Execute.

gain.name: Launch
gain.text: {=effects.0.ap} AP and all your Momentum (at least {=effects.0.res.momentum}): heave an enemy next to you away. It takes a blow that grows with each Momentum beyond the first {=effects.0.res.momentum}, then makes a Body save against your Raw Power: on a failure it is Off Balance, flies {=effects.0.effects.3.tiles} tiles and lands Prone; on a success it staggers back {=effects.0.effects.4.tiles} tile, whatever it was before (an Off Balance it already had is shaken off by the throw). Whatever it lands on (fire, a trap) acts on it. A Boss takes the blow and the save but is never moved.

gain.name: Wrecker
gain.text: Each blow or shot you land on cover, a barricade or a door gives you {=effects.0.value} Momentum.

gain.name: Breach
gain.text: When you strike cover, a barricade or a door, every enemy you can see within {=effects.0.targets.within} tiles of it is Exposed for a round: the squad's shots find the gap.

effects.say: {self} breaches: the enemy behind it is exposed.

base.name: Skirmisher
base.tagline: The gun hand and quick feet.

resource.rule: Guns build Heat: +1 for a single shot, +2 for a burst, +4 for full auto. Every 2 Heat is −1 to hit, and at the weapon's Heat limit the gun jams (2 AP to clear). Heat falls by 2 at the start of each of your turns. Bows build no Heat and have no recoil; they are silent and their damage grows with Raw Power.

gain.name: Reflex
gain.text: You have {=numbers.reactions} more reaction each round: two in all, of any kind. While you hold a shot, what fires by itself leaves your last reaction for it.

gain.name: Fire and Move
gain.text: Once a turn, after an attack you roll with Dexterity (a shot, a throw, a light blade's cut, a glove's blow), a move of {=effects.1.if.path_tiles_at_most} tile costs no AP and draws no opportunity attack. Strike, step, strike: standing still is the wrong answer.

gain.name: Relocated
gain.text: Your first attack rolled with Dexterity (a shot, a throw, a light blade's cut, a glove's blow) after you move on your turn is at +{=effects.1.value} to hit, and a hit adds {=effects.2.value} more Pressure.

gain.name: Break Them
gain.text: Rout costs you {=effects.0.value|abs} AP less on your turn (never under {=effects.0.min}).

moves.name: Hold the Lane
moves.text: Held shots cost {=effects.0.value|abs} AP less (min {=effects.0.min})
moves.source: rules 1.60 item 4626 (R8): was Speed Loader, which repeated Speed Load (Dexterity 3); the id is kept so saves load

moves.name: Duck and Roll
moves.text: Reaction: step 1 tile before a ranged attack on you, no AP · out of sight cancels it · into cover: {=effects.2.value} to hit

moves.name: Run and Gun
moves.text: Once a turn after you attack: your next move of up to {=numbers.tiles} tiles is free, with no opportunity attack · your next hit adds +{=numbers.pressure} Pressure

base.name: Operative
base.tagline: Never where they are looking: reads, marks and takes their machines apart.

resource.rule: You start each fight with Shadow and hold one more than your Ingenuity gives. You can keep up to 3 enemies Marked at once. You carry 2 toxin doses, +1 for every 3 points of Ingenuity, restocked when you rest.

moves.name: Vanish
moves.text: Fade costs no Shadow
moves.source: rules 1.60 item 4628 (R10): was its own Hide out of view, which repeated Fade; the id is kept so saves load

moves.name: Sabotage
moves.text: {=ap_cost} AP: Stun a machine beside you for {=numbers.rounds} round, no save · or break a barricade · or rig your tile ({=effects.2.damage} damage, Pinned on a failed Body save)

gain.name: Tradecraft
gain.text: You start each fight with {=numbers.start} Shadow, and your Shadow holds one more than your Ingenuity gives. Your Analyze costs {=numbers.analyze_ap} AP and Reads its target: your side sees its next action. Once a turn, Analyzing an enemy that can't see you gives {=numbers.gain} Shadow.

base.name: Sigilist
base.tagline: The Sigil scholar: power, reach and the long script.

resource.shared_rule: Every word you draw adds 1 Flux to your Evoker, which holds 6. If it goes above 6 the Evoker overloads: you take 10 damage for each point over 6, all the Flux bursts into the ambient mana, and the Evoker is locked until the next round. Vent (1 AP) empties your Flux into the ambient mana, which rises by the amount vented.

moves.name: Core Change
moves.text: Swapping a spent core costs 1 AP less (min 1)

moves.name: Bleed the Flux
moves.text: Venting costs 1 AP less · the next glyph after a Vent adds {=effects.1.value|abs} Flux less

base.name: Rigger
base.tagline: Give me a minute and some scrap.

resource.rule: Figments held: the door's count (1 at Visualization 1, 2 at 5, 3 at 7) and one more for the Rigger. Each is kept with the Visualizer's charge (figments.json upkeep).

gain.name: The Rigger's Hands
gain.text: You hold {=numbers.held} more Figment than the door gives (once the door is open) and keep {=numbers.designs} more ready design.
gain.source: rules 1.34: the Rigger's bigger meter (figments-spec.md section 5)

moves.name: Double
moves.text: {=ap_cost} AP, no charge, Visualizer in hand: a Double appears within {=numbers.range_no_door} tiles for {=numbers.rounds} rounds · one at a time, no upkeep
moves.source: rules 1.60 item 4631 (R13): no charge (was 1) and a round longer (was 2): the Rigger's better Double, not a copy of the door's

moves.name: Salvage
moves.text: {=ap_cost} AP, beside a wreck: +{=numbers.charge} Visualizer charge, once a wreck · or release a Figment, charge back · or repair a machine or Figment for {=amounts.repair.base}

moves.name: Redline
moves.text: {=ap_cost} AP, once a turn: a Figment or machine of yours within {=numbers.range} tiles acts now, up to {=numbers.max_ap} AP, free · it takes {=amounts.strain.base} damage

moves.name: Sleight
moves.text: 1 AP, once a scene: swap places with a Figment or an ally within {=effects.0.range} tiles, no opportunity attacks

moves.name: Scrap Sentinel
moves.text: {=ap_cost} AP, once a scene: a Sentinel stands beside a wreck, weapon pile or barricade for {=numbers.rounds} rounds · free, no upkeep
moves.source: rules 1.60 item 4633 (R15): was the Scrap Turret, a body that attacked by itself; the id is kept so saves load

moves.name: The Ledger
moves.text: Heals and shields you give fill the Ledger · your next damage adds {=numbers.factor|pct}% of it, then it empties

moves.name: Take the Weight
moves.text: Reaction: a Bonded ally about to go Down stays on {=effects.0.value} HP and you lose {=amounts.weight.per.0.value|pct}% max HP (only above {=numbers.above|pct}%) · or you take its Stun, Daze or Fear

moves.name: Rally
moves.text: {=effects.0.ap} AP · {=effects.0.res.mp} MP · once a scene: every Bonded ally and every ally within {=effects.0.effects.0.targets.within} tiles heals and loses Fear and Shaken · not you or a Downed ally

resource.rule: The Ledger counts the healing and shielding you give (to allies and to yourself) up to its cap, and your next damaging blow on an enemy spends it as extra damage. MP is the fuel of every Tending verb and move, paid through the Attuner. Supplies are no longer the class's: stims and kits are everyone's gear.

base.name: Channeler
base.tagline: An iron will and a storm in the heart.

resource.max: strain_limit (soul_modules.json strain.limit: 3, +1 at Composure 1, 2, 4, 6 and 8; rules 1.70 item 5539)
resource.shared_rule: Each Begin or cast adds 1 Strain (2 where the ambient mana is Flooded), and each turn you keep holding an Outburst adds 1 more. Strain falls by 1 at the start of each of your turns, and again when you calm your heart: a turn spent still, your first weapon attack of the turn, the first heal, stim, shield or cleanse you give someone each turn, letting a held Outburst go, or Steady the heart. Your Strain limit is 3, and grows with Composure. At the end of your turn each point over the limit burns you for 8 damage that ignores armour. At 3 over the limit you suffer a Mana Short with no roll: you are Stunned and a held Outburst goes off wild. Strain is cleared when the fight ends. Crystallise (3 AP, needs ambient mana of 10 or more) lowers the ambient mana by 10 and makes one standard mana core.

moves.name: Iron Heart
moves.text: Once a fight, on Mana Shock: {=effects.0.value} Strain

moves.name: Occult Library
moves.text: One more design ready · once, out of a fight: learn one more tone

moves.name: Eye of the Storm
moves.text: Once a scene, 0 AP: your next Release this turn adds no Strain and its rider counts one stage higher (max 4)

base.name: Chaplain
base.tagline: The god walks beside you, and strikes where you strike.

resource.rule: Your only pool is Devotion, your standing with your patron (0 to 10, earned as Devotion XP), and the Hymn's wait. No move of yours costs MP, Strain, cores or ammunition of its own. You pray like anyone with Faith (Whispers from Faith 1, Hymns from 3, Witnessed at 5, the Miracle at 7); you also say two prayers nobody else can (Ward, Sanctuary), your weapon carries the god (Smite), and while you are Witnessed your patron stands at your side.

moves.name: Ward
moves.text: Whisper, {=effects.0.ap} AP, no MP: shield an ally in sight for the fight · up to {=effects.0.effects.0.holders} allies at once

moves.name: Smite
moves.text: Once a turn: a weapon hit on a standing foe adds Soul damage through armour, no roll · the foe is Judged until its next turn ends

gain.name: The Patron at Your Side
gain.text: While you are Witnessed your patron stands on your tile as a presence (not a body on the board: never targeted, blocks nothing, sees nothing, moves with you). The first {=numbers.keeps} intervention of a fight does not end Witnessed; the next does. Its interventions land where your weapon struck (a Judged enemy of yours first), and each patron's intervention reaches further (your patron's card says how). It never adds an intervention. Faithful only.

gain.name: Canticle
gain.door_line: Sing the Canticle each turn: you and everyone near you carry your patron's verse, and it grows while you keep singing, until a wound breaks the song.
gain.text: Sing ({=effects.0.ap} AP, once a turn; not a prayer, so your Whisper and your Hymn stay free). You and every ally within {=effects.0.effects.4.targets.within} tiles carry your patron's verse for {=effects.0.effects.4.rounds} rounds (each patron sings its own: the verse's card says what it gives; an Atheist rolls the Whisper's TN for it). Sing again on your next turn and the song grows: the second verse, Rising, which steadies the aim of everyone within {=effects.0.effects.14.targets.within} tile, then, from Faith {=effects.0.effects.13.if.self_skill.faith}, the third, Crescendo, which steadies every aim within {=effects.0.effects.13.targets.within} tiles in its place (neither for the Counting Weaver, whose verse already does). Skip a turn and it starts again from the first verse. A blow that takes your HP breaks the song: the verses on you and on every ally your song reached end (another Chaplain's song on the others holds).

why.self_skill: The Canticle needs a point of Faith.
why.no_flag: You sang this turn. Sing again on your next turn.

effects.say: {self} is hurt and the Canticle breaks.

gain.name: Amen
gain.text: After you pray (a Whisper, a Hymn, a Miracle, your Ward or your Sanctuary), the first hit an ally lands on an enemy that still stands before your next turn rings out: your patron adds {=amounts.amen.base} × your Blessing power Soul damage, with no roll, through armour.

gain.name: Holy Dread
gain.text: When your god's blow (a prayer's damage of yours: a Rebuke, a Smite, an Amen) leaves an enemy at half its HP or less and still standing, it saves (Heart, against your Faith) or is Shaken for {=effects.0.rounds} round. Once a turn.

gain.name: Last Rites
gain.text: A prayer's heal of yours on a Downed ally is ×{=effects.0.value}.

move_pool.note: The Revision 2 base moves under their old class ids (status active: a Revision 3 class names it; shelved: no class does, its code and tests stay).

moves.name: Fire Discipline
moves.text: Aimed: +{=effects.3.value} to hit, no Heat · Once a turn: a {=effects.1.if.tech_ap_at_least}+ AP technique costs {=effects.1.value|abs} AP less

moves.name: Special Ammo
moves.text: One load each of armour-piercing (ignores armour), hollow-point (against doubled armour) and incendiary (Burning), restocked on rest · loading is a reload · {=numbers.load_attacks} attacks a load

moves.name: Killzone
moves.text: Hold two attacks, twice the AP: one at each of the first two foes to enter your line or reach, +{=numbers.hit} to hit · costs {=numbers.spend} reactions · not while Pressed

moves.name: Barrel In
moves.text: {=effects.0.value|abs} Momentum: move up to {=effects.1.value} tiles and strike, no opportunity attacks · first hit a turn on a Shaken or Frightened foe gives {=effects.2.value} Momentum

moves.name: Riposte
moves.text: Answer: a melee miss against you is struck back at 0 AP · costs {=effects.2.value|abs} Momentum · adds your Counter bonus to hit

moves.name: Measured Blow
moves.text: A Finisher that drops its target leaves you {=effects.1.value} Momentum. Once a fight, any Finisher does.
moves.source: rules 1.60 item 4623 (R5): was the Breaker's own Finisher action; the door's Finishers are Cleave, Break, Coup and Launch; rules 1.73 (Body), 0.32: the Strength step (item 5808): Follow Through (Raw Power 5) merged in
moves.short: A Finisher kill leaves you x{=effects.1.value} · once a fight, any Finisher

moves.name: Brace
moves.text: Gain Guard equal to your Durability · Braced: +{=effects.2.value} Defense until you move · Interpose: take a hit meant for a friend beside you, 1 Guard · start each fight with {=effects.4.value} Guard

moves.name: Called Out
moves.text: Challenge costs no Guard · the foe you name is Taunted, no save
moves.source: rules 1.60 item 4619 (R1): Draw Fire merged into Challenge; the id is kept so saves load

moves.name: Reactive Plate
moves.text: Each Guard plate takes {=effects.0.value} off a hit by itself, no AP, no reaction · every {=effects.1.every} Guard spent: +{=effects.1.value} ambient mana

moves.name: Triage
moves.text: {=effects.0.ap} AP · {=effects.0.res.mp} MP: heal a friend beside you or a Bonded friend in sight and stop Bleeding · once an ally a turn · out of a fight it heals {=numbers.rest_mult|more}% more · {=numbers.run_per_stage} a stage map in a run

moves.name: Mark
moves.text: {=ap_cost} AP: a foe you see is Marked until the fight ends · squad +1 to hit it, it can't Hide · 3 Marks at once

moves.name: Toxin
moves.text: {=ap_cost} AP · {=effects.0.value|abs} dose: coat your weapon with Weakened, Slowed or Bleeding · your next hit: Body save or the condition · a Break raises the save

moves.name: Execution
moves.text: A hit that leaves a Marked foe at a quarter HP or less kills it · not Bosses or Celestials

moves.name: Barrage
moves.text: FIRE, FREEZE, SHOCK, STONE and ACID cost {=effects.0.value|abs} charge less to draw

moves.name: Overcharge
moves.text: Once a fight, {=ap_cost} AP: your next glyph costs no charge or AP and may be one word past your limit (max 4 glyphs) · still adds Flux

moves.name: Payload
moves.text: Evoke a Line with double area · adds Flux equal to its glyphs · not with STAY, WAIT or WATCH

moves.name: Raise Cover
moves.text: For {=ap_cost} AP and 1 charge you can Evoke a lone STAY glyph with no Subject as a cover rune, from a tile next to it: full cover on its tile and one tile next to it for 2 rounds + your Sigil duration bonus.

moves.name: Ward
moves.text: Spend 1-3 charge: an ally within 6 tiles gains a shield of 10 x charge spent x your Healing given multiplier. Adds 1 Flux per charge.

moves.name: Seal
moves.text: Spend 2 charge: a 3x3-tile zone in range where, for {=effects.0.rounds} rounds, enemy Sigils cost double charge and enemy Soul spells cost double MP.

moves.name: Quicken
moves.text: Spend 1 charge: an ally within 6 tiles gets +{=effects.0.value} AP on their next turn (AP ceiling applies). On the area map the +1 lands on this overworld round's AP.
moves.future_home: a support Sigil hybrid (Intelligence + Insight or Virtue; batch 3)

moves.name: Inscribe Gear
moves.text: Spend 2 charge (or do it out of combat): write a sigil onto an ally's weapon (+{=effects.0.value|pct}% damage) or torso armour (+5 armour value) until the next rest. One inscription per item.
moves.future_home: a support Sigil hybrid (Intelligence + Insight or Virtue; batch 3)

moves.name: Stored Spell
moves.short: Out of a fight, write a Sigil spell onto an object · in a fight, set it off for {=effects.0.ap} AP
moves.text: Out of a fight, write a whole Sigil spell onto an object: name its words (ones you know, up to your Max Sigil words) and pay its charge now. In a fight, with an Evoker in hand, you set off your oldest stored spell for {=effects.0.ap} AP: it goes off from your tile, in every direction, with its own Reach. You can keep as many stored spells as your Rumination modifier (at least 1), and they fade at your next rest. A spell with STAY, WAIT or WATCH can't be stored. Out of a fight, the Narrator decides what a stored spell does.

moves.name: Bind
moves.text: The BIND word costs {=effects.0.value|abs} charge less, and its Body save is {=effects.1.value} harder to make.
moves.future_home: Blade Scribe (Strength + Intelligence; batch 2) or Berserker (Strength squared; batch 1)

moves.name: Blind and Slow
moves.text: You learn the condition words BLIND, SLOW and MUDDLE (Left Brain Debuff) if you don't know them yet. MUDDLE costs you 1 charge less to draw: 1 instead of 2. BLIND and SLOW already cost the least a glyph can, and no glyph costs less than 1 charge.
moves.future_home: the common words (Revision 4 section 5: BLIND and SLOW go to everyone's Sigil list)

shield_turned.text: at most the shield it had

moves.name: Rewrite
moves.text: Costs {=ap_cost} AP and 3 charge, once per turn, and adds 1 Flux. An enemy you can see within 8 tiles (plus your Sigil range bonus) makes a Brain save against 12 + your strength with Brain Power. If it fails, one helpful state on it flips into its opposite until it would have ended: Braced becomes Prone, +2 to hit becomes −2, a shield becomes damage (at most {=amounts.shield_turned.base} × your Sigil multiplier, and armour applies; the rest of the shield is gone), Hidden becomes revealed and Marked. The engine also flips Overwatch, Guarded, Withdrawing, Inspired, Quickened and Sharpened. The Narrator decides the flip for a state the game doesn't track.

effects.note: Pick the opposite of exotic buffs.

moves.name: Shape
moves.text: The free Pump each turn adds {=effects.0.value|pct}% more damage to a Damage design's Release

moves.name: Storm Front
moves.text: Once a turn: Begin a Bolt or Lance for {=effects.1.value|abs} MP more and it arcs to 2 more foes within 2 tiles, each rolled on its own

moves.name: Heart Surge
moves.text: Once a turn: Release or snap cast one stage higher (not past the top; a snap cast fires at stage {=effects.0.value}) · double Strain

moves.name: Drink It In
moves.text: When an enemy spell hits a shield you made, its mana feeds your Emanator: gain MP equal to the spell's MP cost, or 10 per Sigil word, up to your Max MP.
moves.future_home: Saint (Virtue squared; batch 1) or Adamantile Knight (Endurance + Virtue; batch 2)

moves.name: Sanctuary
moves.short: A Hymn of your own: allies around a tile within {=effects.0.reach.tiles} take half damage until your next turn
moves.text: A Hymn only you can say ({=effects.0.ap} AP; no MP, no Strain): it starts your one Hymn wait, and no Hymn of your patron's until the wait ends. Pick a tile you can see within {=effects.0.reach.tiles} tiles: allies on the 3×3 tiles around it, you included, take half damage until the start of your next turn. It prevents at most {=amounts.sanctuary_cap.base} × your Blessing power in all (growing with your level, like a prayer's shield), then it ends. If you are Faithful, a Sanctuary that is answered makes you Witnessed like your patron's own Hymn. An Atheist rolls for it like a Hymn. Two Sanctuaries on the same tile don't stack. Out of a fight it is the Narrator's to rule (what the sanctuary keeps out), with no MP.

moves.name: Inspire
moves.text: {=effects.0.ap} AP · {=effects.0.res.mp} MP: give a Bonded unit in sight a feeling you have felt · ally: a bonus on its next roll and the feeling's boon · enemy: the feeling's enemy face

effects.say: {self} gives {target} a feeling through the Bond.

moves.name: Brimming
moves.text: Healing past max HP leaves {=amounts.brim.per.0.value|pct}% of the excess as a shield

moves.name: Gift
moves.text: Out of combat, hand an ally one of your ready designs. They cast it once for {=effects.0.ap} AP (Begin and Release), on your MP and your Strain; it goes off at stage 1.

moves.name: Dread
moves.text: Status-school spells that inflict Fear cost {=effects.0.value} MP less, and Fear you inflict lasts 1 extra round.

moves.name: Mind Fog
moves.text: Every condition your Status Outbursts inflict has +{=effects.0.value} to its save TN.

moves.name: Puppet
moves.text: Soul cast AP, 60 MP, Heart save: you choose the target's next action. It can't be made to harm itself directly. Bosses roll the save twice and keep the better.

effects.note: Rule on what counts as harming itself.

moves.name: Silver Tongue
moves.text: Costs {=ap_cost} AP. An enemy within {=effects.0.range} tiles that can hear you makes a Brain save against your Charisma. If it fails, it loses {=effects.1.value} AP on its next turn (a boss or a Celestial loses {=effects.1.boss_value}). It doesn't work on machines, turrets or drones.
moves.future_home: none (Revision 4 ruling 6: talk is no class's move)

moves.name: Field Fix

repair.text: a repair, not a heal: no healing multipliers

moves.text: {=ap_cost} AP, no spare part: Field Repair within {=numbers.reach} tiles · clear a jam · restore durability · repair a machine or Figment for {=amounts.repair.base}
moves.future_home: Rigger (Classes 3.0 step 8; figments-spec.md 4): it left the Operative in rules 1.32, its key stays

advanced_roadmap.fantasy: One word over the whole field
Every feeling in the room is fuel
An armourless skirmisher with rallying banners
Plate that turns blows into shields
Sees the sin, delivers the sentence

advanced.name: Gunslinger
advanced.summary: Gunplay with a swordsman's footwork.

moves.name: The Draw
moves.text: Before the first initiative turn of a combat, fire one single shot with a pistol or revolver for 0 AP.

moves.name: Six for Six
moves.text: Fire up to six single shots from a pistol or revolver at targets within 4 tiles. Recoil and Heat apply to each.

moves.name: Called Shot
moves.text: Costs {=ap_cost} AP. With any weapon (a shot, a throw, or a strike in reach), name the head, an arm or a leg and attack at {=effects.0.value} to hit, or with no penalty while the target can't see you. A hit causes that injury without needing a critical hit: head, Dazed; arm, −2 to attacks with that arm; leg, half Movement. A target with Injury resistance can still resist it.

advanced.name: Hellraiser Heavy
advanced.summary: Emplaced, belt-fed fire that makes ground impossible to stand on.

moves.name: Emplace
moves.text: Become Emplaced: heavy weapons lose their unemplaced penalty, you ignore recoil, and you gain +5 armour until you move.
moves.future_home: Hellraiser Heavy (Agility + Virtue or a Mind attribute; batch 3)

moves.name: Suppression
moves.text: While Emplaced, fire full auto into a 3x3-tile area. Until your next turn, any enemy there that moves or attacks takes one attack roll from you and is Pinned on a hit (Body save).
moves.future_home: Hellraiser Heavy (Agility + Virtue or a Mind attribute; batch 3)

moves.name: Belt Discipline
moves.text: While Emplaced, your weapon's Heat limit is +{=effects.0.value} and it loses 4 Heat at the start of your turn instead of 2.
moves.future_home: Hellraiser Heavy (Agility + Virtue or a Mind attribute; batch 3)

advanced.name: CCEC Ballistician
advanced.summary: Ballistics and weak points; one shot closes a case.

moves.name: Case File
moves.text: Analyze costs {=ap_cost} AP and also Marks the target.

moves.name: Weak Point
moves.text: Your Aimed shots against a Marked target ignore armour and are critical on a natural 18-20.

moves.name: One Shot
moves.text: If you haven't moved this turn, an Aimed shot at a Marked target deals triple damage (double against a Boss or a Celestial). Once per fight.

advanced.name: Banner Dancer
advanced.summary: Armourless skirmisher whose mana-thread banners shield and rally allies.

moves.name: Banner Thread
moves.text: With no torso armour (Class 0) you get +{=effects.0.value} Defense and +1 Movement.

moves.name: Rally Banner
moves.text: Plant a banner. Allies who start their turn within 2 tiles of it gain a shield of {=effects.0.value} × your Healing given (doesn't stack) while you stay within 3 tiles of it.

moves.name: Sweep
moves.text: Spend {=effects.0.value|abs} Momentum: move up to 3 tiles. Make one melee attack against each enemy you pass adjacent to; each ally you pass heals 10 × your Healing given.
moves.future_home: Berserker (Strength squared; batch 1) or Banner Dancer (Agility + Insight; batch 2)

advanced.name: RTC Contractor
advanced.summary: Credit buys supply drops, strikes and extractions.

moves.name: Supply Drop
moves.text: Spend {=effects.0.value|abs} credits: next round a crate lands within 6 tiles. Anyone adjacent can take 1 Supply or one magazine from it (1 AP).

moves.name: Strike Call
moves.text: Spend {=effects.0.value|abs} credits: at the start of your next turn, a 3x3-tile area takes 50 Physical damage. Anyone inside can spend their reaction to move 1 tile.

effects.note: No strikes where the Company has no signal.

moves.name: Extraction
moves.text: Spend {=effects.0.value|abs} credits: a Company flyer lifts the squad out after 2 rounds.

effects.note: Decide where the flyer can land and what follows.

advanced.name: Blade Scribe
advanced.summary: Evoker blades: each sword form draws a sigil.

moves.name: Sword Form
moves.text: Each melee attack can also draw one Sigil glyph on your own tile for no extra AP. It still costs charge and adds Flux.

moves.name: Edge Sigil
moves.text: A damage word drawn through Sword Form adds its element damage to that hit as Elemental damage.

moves.name: Three-Cut Script
moves.text: Three melee attacks, each drawing one word; the three words resolve as one spell after the third cut.

advanced.name: Siege Engineer
advanced.summary: Deployable cover and turrets reinforced with STAY cover runes.

moves.name: Deploy Cover
moves.text: Place a portable barricade on an adjacent tile: half cover, 40 HP. Draw a STAY glyph on a tile next to it to make it full cover.

moves.name: Sentry Turret
moves.text: Spend 2 charge: deploy a turret ({=effects.0.hp} HP, Defense 10) that fires once per round at the nearest enemy (+4 to hit, 20 damage). One at a time.

moves.name: Bulwark Line
moves.text: Until your next turn, all cover within 3 tiles that has an ally beside it counts as full cover and gains 20 HP.

advanced.name: Spellslinger
advanced.summary: Sigils inscribed on rounds: every magazine carries a stored spell.

damage.text: the inscribed word's own damage, at this share

moves.name: Inscribed Rounds
moves.text: Out of combat, spend 1 charge per round to inscribe up to 6 rounds with a one-word effect (an element or a condition word).

moves.name: Spell Magazine
moves.text: Store a full Sigil spell in a magazine. The first hit after loading it triggers the spell at the target.

moves.name: Ricochet Glyph
moves.text: When a shot misses, it can glance to another target within 4 tiles of the first: roll again at -2.

advanced.name: Storm Hand
advanced.summary: One element infused into a weapon through an Emanator gauntlet; melee hits charge it and carry the element's rider.

fire_extra.text: Fire, when the hit is not a critical

arc.text: Shock, to one enemy next to the target

moves.name: Gauntlet Infusion
moves.text: Choose one element at each rest (fire, freeze, shock or spark). Your melee hits deal +{=effects.0.value} Elemental damage of it for {=effects.1.value|abs} MP a hit (no Strain) and carry its stage-1 rider, with its effect and sound: Fire sets Burning 1 round on a critical, else +5 more; Shock chains to one enemy next to the target for half; Freeze Slows (Body save); Spark gives +1 AP on a kill.

moves.name: Charged by Battle
moves.text: Each melee hit you land gives {=effects.0.value} Charge (max {=effects.0.max}). Charges fade after combat (battle, not kills).

moves.name: Discharge
moves.text: Spend all Charges with a melee hit: everyone adjacent to the target takes 20 Elemental damage per Charge and the infused element's rider at stage N (N = the Charges spent; the Outburst tone table: fire Fire, shock Storm, freeze Frost; spark has none), with full effects and screen shake.

advanced.name: Adamantile Knight
advanced.summary: Plate that hardens when struck and turns shed mana into shields for allies.

moves.name: Adamantile Plate
moves.text: Each time Reactive Plate spends Guard, the adjacent ally lowest on HP gains a shield of 10 per Guard you lost.

moves.name: Bulwark of Will
moves.text: Brace also gives you a shield of {=effects.0.value} x your Healing given multiplier.

moves.name: Unbroken
moves.text: Once per fight, the first time damage would drop you to 0 HP, you stay at 1 HP instead and gain {=effects.0.and.0.value} Guard.

advanced.name: Shade
advanced.summary: Silent kills that leave fear behind; marked targets see their nightmares.

moves.name: Silent Kill
moves.text: A kill from Hidden doesn't reveal you.

moves.name: Nightmare Mark
moves.text: Enemies you Mark make a Heart save at the start of each of their turns or are Afraid of you (Fear) that turn.

moves.name: Lingering Dread
moves.text: When you kill an enemy, every other enemy within 3 tiles of it that saw it die makes a Heart save against 12 + your strength with Will Power, or is Shaken for 3 rounds.

advanced.name: Lumeri Templar
advanced.summary: The paladin: Blessings fired as shells, a patron watching, Judgement.

moves.name: Blessed Arms
moves.text: When a prayer of yours succeeds, you can load the Hymn into your weapon instead of using it at once, whatever the weapon is (a round, an arrow, an edge, a thrown blade). Your next hit with it releases it: a harmful Hymn lands on the target, a helpful one on every ally next to the target. It stays loaded until that hit or the end of the fight. A Smite may ride the same hit.

moves.name: Under the Eye
moves.text: While you are Witnessed, allies within 3 tiles of you get +2 to hit. Out of a fight they get +2 on checks the Narrator counts as on your patron's theme.

moves.name: Verdict
moves.text: Costs {=ap_cost} AP and 1 Devotion ({=effects.0.value|abs} Devotion XP), once per fight. Make one plain attack with your weapon, whatever it is (a strike, a shot or a throw; never a Burst, an Aimed shot or a technique), that deals damage × (1 + your Blessing power). The Devotion is spent even if you miss.

advanced.name: Stroke Gambler
advanced.summary: Random half-sigils stitched into whole spells.

moves.name: Half-Sigil
moves.text: Draw a random word from those you know (the engine rolls) as a half-glyph on your own tile. It costs 1 charge and adds Flux.

moves.name: Stitch
moves.text: Cast a spell built only from Half-Sigils and roll a d20: 1-5 it hits you or your nearest ally instead; 16-20 its damage doubles.

moves.name: House Edge
moves.text: Once per combat, reroll a Stitch roll.

advanced.name: Devoted
advanced.summary: A few spells, loved and boosted beyond anyone else's.

moves.name: Beloved Spells
moves.text: Choose up to 3 ready designs as Beloved. They cost 30% less MP and get +{=effects.1.value} module slot.

moves.name: Heart's Own
moves.text: While you Begin or hold a Beloved spell, your Strain limit is {=effects.0.value} higher: the burn and the Mana Short count from it.

moves.name: Love Made Manifest
moves.text: Once per combat, a Beloved Outburst Begins at stage {=effects.0.value}: the heart full at once.

advanced.name: Circuit Mage
advanced.tutor: The Institute of Forgotten Knowledge, in secret
advanced.summary: Vents and crystallises in one body: the only caster who needs nobody's cores.

requires.tutor: The Institute of Forgotten Knowledge, in secret

moves.name: Closed Loop
moves.text: When you Vent, your own Emanator takes the Flux as 10 MP per Flux instead of the air.

moves.name: Self-Crystallise
moves.text: Crystallise from your own MP: spend {=effects.0.value|abs} MP to make a standard core, ignoring the meter. As many cores between long rests as your Virtue.

moves.name: Fusion
moves.text: Cast a spell that joins Sigil words that aren't Subjects (Reach, Delivery, Burst, Filter) to a Soul school: each creature the Sigil reaches takes the Outburst as a Bolt, at stage 0 (×0.8) or at the stage you held it to. Pay both costs, +1 Strain and +2 Flux. Celestials notice.

effects.note: Each Fusion in sight of the world is a Knowing risk: decide whether a Celestial takes an interest.

advanced.name: Glyph Mason
advanced.summary: A mason's-chisel Evoker: one Keystone glyph that never fades, and the fight is planned around it.

moves.name: Keystone
moves.text: Cut a glyph on your own tile instead of drawing it ({=ap_cost} AP + {=effects.0.cost_core} standard core): it never fades, can't be scuffed, doesn't count toward your glyph limit and survives being Evoked. One at a time; it stays in that zone until you cut another.

moves.name: Survey
moves.text: You and your allies can Evoke a Line that holds your Keystone from up to 2 tiles away, and it costs 1 charge less to fire.

moves.name: Foundation
moves.text: Once per scene: this turn, glyphs you draw within 2 tiles of your Keystone cost 0 AP.

advanced.name: Grand Sigilist
advanced.summary: A staff Evoker: one word enlarged into a Grand form over the battlefield, and bare hands while the staff stands planted.

moves.name: Enlarge
moves.text: Once per combat ({=ap_cost} AP + {=effects.0.charge} charge): plant the staff and enlarge one word you know into its Grand form (sigils.json, grand) over radius 2 around the staff for {=effects.0.rounds} rounds + duration bonus. While planted you can't draw or Evoke; pulling it out (1 AP, adjacent) ends it.

moves.name: Empty Hand
moves.text: With empty hands, unarmed strikes deal {=effects.1.value} Physical for 2 AP, and you get +{=effects.0.value} Defense.

moves.name: Earthed
moves.text: Inside your own Grand form you ignore its harm, and your unarmed strikes carry its element.

advanced.name: Heartfed
advanced.summary: Every feeling in the room is fuel: Rage, Grief, Fear and Devotion fill four gauges that feed the Outbursts keyed to them.

moves.name: Four Hearts
moves.text: Four gauges, 0-{=effects.0.max}: Rage (+1 per 20 damage you take), Grief (+2 when an ally is Downed, +5 when one dies), Fear (+1 when a fight with an Elite or Boss starts, +2 when you're Shaken), Devotion (+1 when an ally heals or buffs you). Each design is keyed to one.

moves.name: Fed
moves.text: Your Outbursts cost {=effects.0.per_point|pct}% less MP per point in their key gauge. While you hold one, spend {=effects.0.pump_per_point} point of its gauge for a Pump (2 a turn). The first costs no AP; a character takes one free stage a turn, so the second costs the Pump's AP. Releasing it empties that gauge.

moves.name: Overflow
moves.text: Once per scene, when a gauge reaches 5, your next Outburst keyed to it Begins at stage 2 (the held stage itself) with no Strain.

advanced.name: Heartbinder
advanced.summary: Heart links: cast from a linked ally's place, share their wounds, heal through the bond.

moves.name: Link
moves.text: Bind your heart to one ally within {=effects.0.range} tiles (two from Will Power 5) for the scene, or until you're Downed.

mirror.text: a share of the heal or shield you received, to each linked ally

moves.name: Through
moves.text: Snap-cast (Begin and Release, at stage 0) or Release your held Outburst from a linked ally's position: range, sight and the shape run from their tile. Buffs you receive reach them at half.

moves.name: Share
moves.text: When a linked ally takes damage, take up to half of it yourself. Strain that would take a linked ally over their limit comes to you instead (as far as your limit allows); Take their Strain (1 AP, once a turn) moves up to 2. Heals you send through a link are x1.25. If a linked ally is Downed, you take 2 Strain.

effects.when: a linked ally's Strain would pass their limit; action take_strain moves 2

advanced.name: Vessel
advanced.summary: No Outbursts: the heart charges the body instead, then lets it all go in one strike.

moves.name: Inner Charge
moves.text: Begin's 2 AP, {=effects.0.mp} MP, 1 Strain: hold a body form like an Outburst. It starts at stage 1 and reads the stage table from there (stage 1 to stage 4), swells a stage each turn (1 Strain each) and can be Pumped ({=effects.0.pump_ap} AP, or an Empathy free Pump). Iron (armour +10), Surge (melee and unarmed damage +15), Swift (+2 Movement), Pain to Power (+{=effects.0.pump_ap} AP next turn per 20 damage taken, up to +2), Steady (no Prone or push; +2 Body saves), Heartbeat (heal 10 at turn start). At most 2 forms at once, whatever your Will Power.

damage.text: each form, times its stage multiplier

moves.name: Release
moves.text: End every form at once in one strike (free with a melee hit): +{=effects.0.per_stage} Soul damage x each form's stage multiplier, summed.

moves.name: Empty Hand
moves.text: Unarmed strikes deal {=effects.0.value} Physical for 2 AP. The Vessel can't design or cast Outbursts.

advanced.name: Twinbound
advanced.summary: Your soul's twin in the upper realm leans through: a companion with its own turn and three built-in Outbursts.

moves.name: Manifest
moves.text: Out of combat, once: design your Twin, its look (a portrait card) and three built-in Outbursts from schools and modules you know. They are fixed.

moves.name: Call
moves.text: The Twin appears within 3 tiles and takes its own turn after yours with {=effects.0.ap} AP: move, work its built-in Outbursts with its own heart (Begin, Pump, hold and Release at its own stage; your MP, your Strain; you and it don't resonate with each other) or Guard you. HP 50% of yours, your Defense, Movement 1.5, your Will Power; at most 6 tiles from you. On the area map the twin is a token with its own {=effects.0.ap} AP a round (moves only) and joins a fight opened there as the called twin.

moves.name: Bond
moves.text: If the Twin drops to 0 HP it vanishes and you take {=effects.0.strain} Strain; call it again next scene. In game text it is only ever the twin, and it never speaks of the upper realm.
